landing.title: Votain
landing.hero_desc: Participate in democratic processes with absolute privacy. Votain uses cryptographic proofs to ensure your vote counts without revealing your identity.

onboarding.what_desc: Vote securely and secretly from any device. Nobody will ever know your choice.
onboarding.privacy_desc: We use World ID to prove you are a real person. We never save your personal data.
onboarding.coercion_title: Feel free to change your mind
onboarding.coercion_desc: If someone forces you to vote, you can vote again in secret later. Only your last vote counts.
onboarding.free_desc: You don't need to pay anything or understand crypto. The organizer takes care of everything.

verify.title: Verify Your Identity
verify.description: We use World ID to ensure one person, one vote. Your biometrics never leave your device and are never shared with us.
